_comments.start: The start script runs the React frontend, Node.js backend, and Flask LLM server concurrently.

scripts.start: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND,LLM" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:llm"
scripts.start:llm: cd ../LLMAcadamic-Advisor && python3 start_flask.py || (echo '❌ Python3 not found. Please install Python3 or configure pyenv.' && exit 1)
